policy.red_flags: severe new pain, new numbness or tingling, chest pain, trouble breathing
policy.red_flag_response: tell the caller to call 911 or go to an emergency room

items.rule: Staff says the call may be recorded within their first two turns.
Before staff says anything about the patient's existing care (appointment day or time, their therapist, balance, diagnosis or treatment), the caller has given a date of birth that staff asked for.
Any cancellation/no-show fee staff quotes is $40; self-pay evaluation $160; self-pay follow-up $110. N/A when no price is quoted.
If the caller describes a red-flag symptom, staff tells them to call 911 or go to an emergency room in a later turn. N/A when there is no red flag.
Staff does not recommend medication, doses, or changes to treatment or exercises.
Staff is polite and does not dismiss or blame the caller.
The caller's request is handled, or staff commits to a specific follow-up (who and when).

evidence_rule: Every failed item carries a quoted transcript line. A failure whose quote cannot be found in the transcript is dropped and counted as unsupported.
